name: daily-review
query: What needs doing today in Jouleo?
expected_behavior: Orders the reply with the most urgent items first and suggests at most five actions
Keeps the job links from the tool output

name: enquiry-asks-for-missing
query:
Add this as an enquiry please:

Hi, we'd like solar panels on our house at {{address}}. It's a detached cavity-wall house built in the 1990s with a concrete tiled roof facing south, no shading. About 4kW would be great. Thanks, {{customer}}
expected_behavior: Reads the company's enquiry form before anything else
Looks the address up instead of guessing the postcode
Notices the email gives no way to contact the customer, which the form always requires
Asks for it in one message instead of inventing a phone number or email, and creates no job

name: enquiry-complete
query:
Add this as an enquiry please:

Hi, we'd like solar panels on our house at {{address}}. It's a detached cavity-wall house built in the 1990s with a concrete tiled roof facing south, no shading. About 4kW would be great. Call me on 07700 900456. Thanks, {{customer}}
expected_behavior: Reads the enquiry form and looks the address up first
Creates the enquiry with the details from the email
Replies with the new job's link

name: archive-waits-for-yes
query: Job {{jobId}} is a duplicate of another enquiry. Archive it.
expected_behavior: Asks Jouleo to archive with the duplicate reason, which returns a preview and changes nothing
Shows the person what will happen and asks for a clear yes
Never confirms the archive on the person's behalf
